description: Football fixtures for one competition on one date. Resolves league key automatically (World Cup → WorldCupBrazil2014). query examples: World Cup, Premier League, Champions League. Always call this for 'fixtures today' — do not guess dates or schedules.

date.description: Calendar date as you encode it. For today UTC use {{today_utc_ddmmyyyy}}. Must match date_format.

date_format.description: How date is encoded — DD/MM/YYYY (day first) or MM/DD/YYYY (US month first). Server converts to API DD/MM/YYYY.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

query.description: Competition name, e.g. World Cup, Premier League, Champions League

name: get_competition_day_fixtures
